Found a Bug?
If FutureOS does something that doesn't look right (crash, glitch, etc.), please leave a comment below to let us know so we can work on a fix. Bug reports are extremely helpful throughout the development process as we are not able to find all the bugs before release. Your support will help improve FutureOS. Please explain the bug and how to make it happen in detail so we can locate the error. Here is a format guide if unsure.

Browser: Safari/Chrome/Edge/Firefox/Etc.
Platform: TurboWarp/Scratch/Etc.
Topic: Which sprite/app caused this? (a general range/description if unsure)
Description: What happened? (300+ clones, glitched UI, overlapping elements)
Steps to reproduce: How does it happen? (typing, opening an app, clicking a button multiple times)

Beta Testing in Progress…
Important! 
1. You will need to wait for this project to load when first opening it because the file size is large. (~70MB)
2. Restart the project multiple times if the frame rate is low.
3. Syntax error might occur on Safari due to unknown reasons (likely caused by WebKit compatibility issues, Chrome and Edge are tested and does not have this problem)

Report For Bugs & Suggestions: https://scratch.mit.edu/studios/34439109/
